newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr strengthens against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr strengthens against the dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr strengthened marginally against the dollar on Monday, the central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said.
It quoted the birr at a mean rate of 6.6310 against the dollar compared to 6.6510 last week.
The bank said that following a currency auction on March 22, the applicable rate for all transactions outside the auction in the March 24 to 29 period would be 6.6310 to the dollar.
The bank posted the birr at a mean rate of 10.5598 against the pound sterling from 10.6050 last week, while against the yen, the birr traded at 0.053814 from 0.054254 last week.
